# Packages that must meet COVER_MIN (default 95%) in CI.
# Patterns match exact package-path suffixes of the Go coverprofile.
# CI also sets COVER_EXCLUDE_FILE_REGEX='(^|/)store\.go$' so PgStore DB code
# under internal/livetv is omitted from the livetv package total.
#
# Prefer packages with solid unit tests over artificially narrow includes.
# When adding a package here, also add it to the go-test-coverage job in
# .github/workflows/ci.yml so coverage.out contains its profile data.
internal/livetv
internal/livetv/hdhomerun
internal/contentid
internal/librarykind
internal/logredact
internal/logfilter
internal/titleutil
internal/lang
internal/rootcheck
internal/secret
internal/providerid
internal/buildinfo
internal/artworkkey
# internal/imageutil is exercised in go-test-coverage (embedded WASI smoke) but
# stays off the 95% gate until processor error paths have dedicated unit tests.
